title: Ginga Ojousama Densetsu Yuna 3: Lightning Angel
native_title: 銀河お嬢様伝説 ユナ３ ～ライトニング・エンジェル～
overview:
Yuna and her friends are enjoying a relaxing day shopping when suddenly an intergalactic army appears with plans of conquering the Earth. With the fate of the planet on the line, Yuna and her rivals must put aside their differences and fight back against this intergalactic menace.

Ginga Ojōsama Densetsu Yuna 3: Lightning Angel is the third mainline game in the Galaxy Fräulein Yuna series. Gameplay is very different from prior entries in the series; while story sequences are presented in the same digital-comic format as the previous games, this time the battle sequences take center stage and are presented as isometric turn-based strategy battles in the vein of Tactics Ogre. The player can control a team of up to eight characters depending on the scenario, and each character has their own abilities and special techniques. Choices made during the adventure sequences can also affect the particular conditions of the following battle.
